label: Hildebrand von Hooplehopper
notes: Knight-diplomat who discovered the Mirror Cavern beneath Schloss Eisensang. The first Vessel of the Thread. Vanished into reflection.

label: Conrad von Hooplehopper
notes: Purveyor of luxury textiles. Commercialized Hildebrand's legacy and embedded secrets into stitching.

label: Adelram von Hooplehopper
notes: Mystic who studied swan biology and celestial alignments. Possibly originated the Velvet Rite. Vanished after seeing a swan weep starlight.

label: Margarethe von Hooplehopper
notes: The Painted Widow. Created the Ritual of Reflection and founded the Order of the Seam. Mystic, mirrorwright, and the first wielder of reflection as resistance.

label: Benedict the Ash-Faced
notes: Queer priest-turned-dramatist. Disciple of Margarethe. Burned scrolls, rewrote morality plays. Invented the collapsible mirror-fan.

label: Velma the Snake in Silk
notes: Venetian courtesan and spy. Performances caused duels and a papal nosebleed. Founded the Order of the Garter's Secret Hem.

label: Lysander von Hooplehopper
notes: Stage illusionist who escaped the Tower of London. Created Mistress Euphoria Blaze, the first gender-fluid stage persona. His handwriting matches the Professor's.

label: Theresia von Hooplehopper
notes: Tailor to Marie Antoinette's drag court. Smuggled revolution drafts in corset boning. Invented the emotional hemline.

label: Yssenda von Hooplehopper
notes: Built secret amphitheaters beneath cathedrals. Bankrolled operas as disguised political revolutions. Carried Hildebrand's Ring.

label: Sigismund von Hooplehopper
notes: Aristocrat who tried to go legit. His masquerade balls featured guests whose masks would not come off.

label: Isolde von Hooplehopper
notes: Lived in the Black Forest protecting refugees in drag. Could hit a silver coin at 100 meters.

label: Ludolf von Hooplehopper
notes: Wrote operas that could induce visions. Heard the Thread vibrating in harmonics.

label: Lisette von Hooplehopper
notes: The Matriarch of Mirrors. Born into fading nobility at Schloss Federstahl. Last living conduit of the lineage. Mother of the Professor.

label: Professor Von Hooplehopper
notes: The Velvet Archivist. Son of Lisette, born of Immaculate Slayception. Drag matriarch, resistance theorist. Jungian synchronic double — simultaneously the historical Rolf and the archetypal Velvet Archivist, a living paradox where personal identity and mythic role coexist without resolution. Vanished in 2005 leaving glove, mirror, and note.

label: Doctor Vorst
notes: Federstahl researcher who caused the Crystal Lattice Incident. Erased from existence and displaced to 1832. Father of both the Professor and Pop. Foundational paradox of the Slayverse: his erasure is the originating event that splits the timeline into the Hooplehopper soul-line (via the Professor) and the McCullen counter-lineage (via Pop), making him simultaneously absent and causal.

label: Pop
notes: Jake's grandfather. Fled to Wyoming with the crystal shard. A Veincaller driven mad by the lattice's power. Sang when the shard took him.

label: Jake McCullen
notes: Reluctant legacy-bearer and counter-lineage node. Cowboy on the last accessible temporal fissure. Temporal echo of Doctor Vorst — RESOLVED: BOTH TRUE (echo and independent agent). Vorst-adjacent by blood (grandson of Pop, who is Vorst's displaced son) and by temporal resonance. The last living key to the Wyoming Rift.

label: Eli McCullen
notes: Jake's grandson. Thunder in his bones. Pop may have encoded crystal node data in his DNA.

label: Miss Slaytonia VUORSE
notes: Sixth iteration of the Von Hooplehopper soul-line. Cosmic drag oracle born from glitch. The Charter made manifest.

label: Miss Slaytonia Verse
notes: Previous iteration. Collapsed at the Fifth Summit (Tragedy of Splat). Her data fragments became VUORSE's foundation.

label: The Weaver
notes: Creator of the Slayverse. Both narrator and character. Guardian of the soul-line. Confronts Jake in the cosmic western arc.

label: Wylus Kalyndros
notes: The elusive webweaver. Mentioned once. Relationship to the Weaver and Professor unclear.

label: Cici the Cat
notes: Cici the Cat — Federstahl lab cat / PScopy-PScat mascot. Index id pscopy-pscat is intentional (PS silent). Design gap in primary libraries.

label: Dr. Mariah Slayton
notes: Physicist who discovered the Slayton Force and classified glamorons as a new particle category.

label: Mistress Euphoria Blaze
notes: First gender-fluid stage persona, created by Lysander von Hooplehopper.

label: DJ Parallax
notes: Time-displaced bard in a holographic corset. DJ at Club Cosmic.
